properties.description: Scans Copilot Studio agents for unsafe sharing configurations and records violations in Dataverse. Implements 5 violation rules: ORG_WIDE_SHARING, PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK, UNAPPROVED_GROUP, EXCESSIVE_INDIVIDUAL, CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511/3110, SEC 17a-3/4, SOX 302/404. Part of the FSI Agent Governance — Unrestricted Agent Sharing Detector solution.
